import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.NatIso
import Data.Finset
import Data.Nat

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u₂, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor C FintypeCat) {X Y : C} (i : X ≅ Y) : Nat.card (F.obj X).obj = Nat.card (F.obj Y).obj := by
  let σ : F.obj X ≅ F.obj Y := NatIso.ofComponents.app F F (λ _ => id) (λ _ _ => rfl) i.is_iso
  have h : (σ.app X).hom = (σ.app Y).hom ∘ (F.map i) := by rw [NatIso.ofComponents.app_app, NatIso.ofComponents.app_app, NatIso.ofComponents.naturality, id_comp]
  let f : (F.obj X).obj ≅ (F.obj Y).obj := σ
  exact Nat.subtype_card (f.hom) (Finset.card_eq_of_bijection f.hom f.inv)
